style: 既存の彩色人物画に合わせた腰までの透過画像。肖像・立ち絵で共用。ルゴとペラが退避所の荷役であることは原文の設定。具体的な年代・性別・外見・服装は今回の美術設定。縄・空箱・荷物・合図板・壁・作業状態は人物画に固定せず、本文と既存処理で扱う。

files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an isolated transparent dialogue character cutout for a Japanese dungeon RPG. One centered adult person in a waist-up composition, complete head silhouette and both empty hands fully visible, lower edge below the waist, generous empty transparent margins beside the shoulders and above the head. Vertical portrait canvas, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Detailed painted game illustration with tactile linen and worn canvas, readable facial features, muted earthy colors, soft warm light from upper left, eye-level three-quarter view. Deliver a PNG with genuine transparent alpha throughout the surrounding area. Clothing surfaces are plain and unlettered. Subject: Rugo, a cargo worker at a border settlement refuge, focused on pulling loads safely. He is a man in his late thirties with a stocky strong build, warm tan skin, a broad square face, dark brown eyes, very short black hair and a clean-shaven jaw. He wears a faded brick-red sleeveless work vest over an oatmeal linen shirt with rolled sleeves and a plain charcoal cloth sash at the waist. His expression is attentive and earnest, mouth relaxed, eyebrows slightly furrowed as he listens carefully. Both empty hands are relaxed and fully visible near the waist. His sturdy shoulders, close-cropped hair and brick-red vest create a clear silhouette. The portrait must remain usable during an initial misunderstanding and a later cooperative resolution; show a neutral listening posture.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：日本語ダンジョンRPGの透過会話人物画。成人1人を中央に置き、頭部の輪郭と空の両手全体が入り、腰より下で自然に終わる構図。肩の左右と頭上に十分な透過余白。1024×1536の縦画面。麻と使い込まれた帆布の質感を備えた緻密な彩色ゲーム人物画。読み取りやすい顔、落ち着いた土色、左上から柔らかな暖色光、目の高さからの斜め正面。周囲の全域に透明なアルファを持つPNG。衣服の表面は無地。人物は国境宿場の退避所で、安全に荷を引くことを大切にする荷役ルゴ。30代後半の男性。がっしりした体格、温かい褐色の肌、幅のある四角い顔、濃い茶色の目、ごく短い黒髪、ひげのない顎。袖をまくったオートミール色の麻シャツに、色褪せた煉瓦色の袖なし作業上着を重ね、腰に無地の炭色の布帯を締める。注意深く真剣な表情で、口元は力を抜き、話をよく聞くように眉を少し寄せる。空の両手全体を腰付近に自然に見せる。頑丈な肩、短く刈った髪、煉瓦色の上着で見分けられる。誤解がある最初の場面と協力して解決する後の場面で共用できる、中立的に話を聞く姿勢。
